architect.reply:
Yes
The record design and task force structure are sound and minimal. Mirroring play-tracker's reference schema for service, model, work-type, and outcome keeps the jsonl format standard, and excluding failed seats from rotation turns prevents unfair rotation penalties. Scoping the changes strictly to light unit tests in mob-defaults avoids unnecessary heavy runs and false positives. Note: parser routines reading historical rows should gracefully tolerate missing fields in pre-existing records.
CITE: Work only in a linked worktree of mob-defaults, with light runs only.
